title: Full generation and canonical section maps descend over base opens
statement: Let $h:Z\to S$ be a quasi-compact separated morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism], and let $N$ be an invertible module on $Z$ [def-sc-invertible-module]. Let $(U_i)_{i\in I}$ be an affine open cover indexed by any type $I$, put $j_i:Z_i=h^{-1}U_i\hookrightarrow Z$, $h_i:Z_i\to U_i$, and $N_i=j_i^*N$ with tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. Let $A$ be a relative section algebra for $(h,N)$ and $A_i$ relative section algebras for $(h_i,N_i)$ [def-sfb-relative-section-algebra-canonical-map]. Suppose a coefficientwise pullback datum $D_i$ from $A.data$ to $A_i.data$ along $U_i\hookrightarrow S$ is given for every $i$ [def-nagata-graded-algebra-pullback-data, def-nagata-relative-proj]. Assume its section maps are normalized as follows: for every affine $V\subset S$, affine $W\subset U_i$ with $W\subset (U_i\hookrightarrow S)^{-1}V$, $n\geq0$, and $a\in A(V)_n$, the section associated to $D_i(a)$ is the restriction to $h_i^{-1}W$ of boundaryPullbackPowIso applied to the actual tensor-pullback section $1\otimes\operatorname{sectionEquiv}_{V,n}(a)$ [def-sc-tensor-pullback-power-comparison, def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], including degree zero. If every $A_i$ generates everywhere and $r_i:Z_i\to\operatorname{Proj}_{U_i}(A_i)$ is canonical for $A_i$, then $A$ generates everywhere and there is a canonical $r:Z\to\operatorname{Proj}_S(A)$ such that $j_i\mathbin{\gg}r=r_i\mathbin{\gg}D_i.\mathrm{relProjComparison}$ for every $i$. There is no hypothesis or conclusion that the maps are open immersions.

proof.text: The specified comparison sends a homogeneous section s to its restriction, written as the tensor-pullback unit 1 tensor s followed by the power comparison. On a further trivializing open chart the adjunction evaluation therefore sends b tensor s to b times the same restricted section, both before and after the base restriction. Tensor multiplication and the degree-zero unit are preserved by this formula. Thus it identifies the graded evaluations, not only their sources. The scheme case of space_line_module_proj_map gives the generation-open and canonical map for this evaluation, and its base-change clause, with D_i, identifies their restrictions to h inverse U_i with the local generation opens and canonical maps. The stalk condition defining GeneratesEverywhere is precisely generation of the invertible homogeneous target: over a local ring its maximal-ideal quotient is a one-dimensional vector space, so a section generates exactly when its residue is nonzero. Since all local generation opens are full and the inverse images of U_i cover Z, the global generation open is all of Z. Its canonical map is consequently defined on Z. On each local trivializing principal chart, the normalized section formula makes its homogeneous fraction map identical to that of r_local i. The uniqueness/chart clause of the canonical-map theorem gives the displayed equality after composing with D_i.relProjComparison. The relative-Proj base-change theorem identifies this comparison with the canonical projection from the pullback. Chart uniqueness also verifies the all-chart predicate IsCanonicalMap, including degree zero, so the resulting map has exactly the asserted predicate. No open-immersion hypothesis on any local map is used. Empty Z and the empty cover are allowed.

theorem section_canonical_map_open_descent {Z S : Scheme.{u}} (h : Z ⟶ S)
    [QuasiCompact h] [IsSeparated h] (N : Z.Modules) [N.IsInvertible]
    {I : Type v} (U : I → S.Opens) (hU : ∀ i : I, IsAffineOpen (U i))
    (hcover : iSup U = ⊤) (A : RelativeSectionAlgebra h N)
    (A_local : ∀ i : I, RelativeSectionAlgebra (h ∣_ U i)
      ((tensorPullback (h ⁻¹ᵁ U i).ι).obj N))
    (D : ∀ i : I, Scheme.GradedAlgebraData.PullbackData (U i).ι A.data (A_local i).data)
    (hD : ∀ (i : I) (V : S.affineOpens) (W : (U i).toScheme.affineOpens)
      (hle : W.1 ≤ (U i).ι ⁻¹ᵁ V.1) (n : ℕ) (a : A.data.grading V n),
      (A_local i).sectionEquiv W n
          ⟨(D i).map hle a, ((D i).map hle).map_mem a.property⟩ =
        (((tensorPullback (h ⁻¹ᵁ U i).ι).obj N).tensorPow n).val.map
          (homOfLE (by
            intro x hx
            change h ((h ⁻¹ᵁ U i).ι x) ∈ V.1
            rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← morphismRestrict_ι]
            exact hle hx)).op
          ((boundaryPullbackPowIso (h ⁻¹ᵁ U i).ι N n).hom.app _
            (tensorPullbackSection (h ⁻¹ᵁ U i).ι (N.tensorPow n) (h ⁻¹ᵁ V.1)
              (A.sectionEquiv V n a))))
    (hgen : ∀ i : I, (A_local i).GeneratesEverywhere)
    (r_local : ∀ i : I, (h ⁻¹ᵁ U i).toScheme ⟶ (A_local i).data.relProj)
    (hcanonical : ∀ i : I, (A_local i).IsCanonicalMap (r_local i)) :
    A.GeneratesEverywhere ∧ ∃ r : Z ⟶ A.data.relProj, A.IsCanonicalMap r ∧
      ∀ i : I, (h ⁻¹ᵁ U i).ι ≫ r = r_local i ≫ (D i).relProjComparison
